messages.subject: Project Mallory — Restructuring Options Paper for 1 Dec board
messages.plaintextBody:
Richard, Grace,

Attached is the Restructuring Options Paper for the board meeting on 1 December. In short: the recommended route is a consensual amendment and restatement of the Sterling facilities, bridged by a short standstill to 31 March 2026, with a new ~£6m super-senior money facility, a covenant reset, and a £2m equity injection from shareholders. The paper also covers directors' duties in the current position — please read section 3 carefully.

I'll attend the meeting with James. Duncan Reeves will join for the IBR items.

Sarah

messages.plaintextBody:
Grace — our working assumption is Sterling provides the new money as a super-senior facility (Facility C); that's the cleanest given their existing security. Yes — under the standstill, Sterling agrees not to accelerate or enforce solely by reason of the September defaults until the earlier of 31 March 2026 and a termination event. It is not a waiver; the defaults still subsist. Happy to talk it through before Monday.

Sarah
